name: @sig-net/midnight-examples-erc20-vault-contract
description: The ERC20 vault Compact contract. src/index.ts is the curated export surface — this IS the "sdk" face of the package.
//exports: Local dev consumes raw TS source and the compiler output under src/managed. `publishConfig.exports` below swaps both to the emitted ./dist at publish time, where prepack copies the shippable managed/ parts.

scripts.compile: COMPACT_PATH=../../../node_modules compact compile --skip-zk --feature-zkir-v3 src/erc20-vault.compact src/managed/erc20-vault && rm -f src/managed/SignetNotifier && ln -sfn ../../../../../node_modules/@sig-net/midnight-contract/dist/managed src/managed/SignetSigner
scripts.compile:zk: COMPACT_PATH=../../../node_modules compact compile --feature-zkir-v3 src/erc20-vault.compact src/managed/erc20-vault && rm -f src/managed/SignetNotifier && ln -sfn ../../../../../node_modules/@sig-net/midnight-contract/dist/managed src/managed/SignetSigner
scripts.prepack: ls src/managed/erc20-vault/keys/*.prover >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'erc20-vault-contract prepack: no prover keys in src/managed/erc20-vault/keys, run `yarn compile:zk` first (compile uses --skip-zk)' >&2; exit 1; } && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/managed/erc20-vault && cp -R src/managed/erc20-vault/contract src/managed/erc20-vault/compiler src/managed/erc20-vault/zkir dist/managed/erc20-vault/ && mkdir -p dist/managed/erc20-vault/keys && cp src/managed/erc20-vault/keys/*.verifier dist/managed/erc20-vault/keys/ && mkdir -p dist/managed/SignetSigner && cp -R src/managed/SignetSigner/contract dist/managed/SignetSigner/
